We're launching our payments product and expect around 50,000 daily active users. We want a Docker-based service on ECS behind a load balancer on AWS in us-west-2. It needs a serverless NoSQL data store, global edge delivery with a CDN, queue-based decoupling. The data is regulated (think PCI/HIPAA-style controls), so apply the strictest sensible security posture. Give us a production-ready architecture that won't need rework.
